_meta.description: D6 module -> D7 kit map, consumed by provision-backdrop-d6-upgrade. For each enabled D6 module: kit_projects = pinned kit project directories to stage into the copy's site dir (including hard dependencies of the D7 port), enable = D7 module names to pm-enable after staging (empty when the capability is absorbed elsewhere). Modules absent from this map are parked disabled by the D6->D7 conversion (data tables kept) - advisory, never a gate. content_migrate plus core file/image are always staged/enabled regardless of the map (D-026 item 3): the D6->D7 core upgrade only enables file when D6 upload was in use, and content_migrate misclassifies file/image fields as missing without them.
